name: Caldwell (United States)
description: Divided light blue over white, charged with a six-pointed spur and a stirrup forming a letter C, both divided dark blue over red.
history: Caldwell is a city in Sumner County, Kansas, a cattle-trail town on the Chisholm Trail. Flags of the World records that the flag, designed by Joe Hansen, appears to have been adopted in 2021 for the town's 150th anniversary; in 2010 the city had reported having no flag.
